title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.83
summary: Eigene, geschützte und für Smartphones optimierte Online-Oberfläche mit Kamera-Liveansicht, Vorschaubildern und Aufnahmen.
changes: Automatically route mobile browser sessions to the dedicated authenticated /mobile portal
Offer cached thumbnails, status and search without starting extra camera streams
Reuse central low-bandwidth HLS for a single selected live camera
View and play recordings with existing authenticated APIs
Enable touch-oriented navigation, safe areas and explicit desktop override
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.83
description: Authenticated mobile-first frontend at /mobile with cached thumbnails and an on-demand central HLS player.
releaseNotes: 2.20.83 introduces an independent protected mobile portal for phone/tablet logins: cached camera list, one on-demand central HLS live view, recording playback, responsive touch navigation, session logout and desktop switch. Media backend and kiosk layouts are untouched.
